public_worktree: reuse admitted r2 public files, package-copy isolation and exact official setup tree
parent_git: preserve original official setup HEAD and its complete ancestor closure; retain only original HEAD branch and tags peeling to dataset-base ancestors
submodule_git: preserve current official gitlink commit and its complete ancestor closure; retain tags peeling to its ancestors
object_database: new Git database populated only from explicitly allowed heads and tag objects; no original object store, remote refs, reflogs, hooks or unrelated branches copied
runtime_version: compare actual public module import/version between pinned original image and derived Actor image before admission
